scheme_name: Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana
description:
The Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2018. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to the children of weavers and artisans. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to encourage and support the education of talented children from weaving families. 

The scheme is designed to promote the educational aspirations of these children. 

It targets students who excel in their studies and have a background in weaving. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to alleviate the financial burden on families. 

The scheme aims to ensure that children from these families can pursue higher education without financial constraints. 

The benefits under this scheme include monetary awards for students who perform well academically. 

Students from Class 1 to Class 12 are eligible to receive these awards. 

The exact amount awarded varies based on the educational level of the student. 

For students in Class 1 to Class 5, the award amount is ₹5,000. 

For students in Class 6 to Class 8, the award amount is ₹10,000. 

For students in Class 9 to Class 12, the award amount is ₹15,000. 

These amounts are intended to support educational expenses such as books, tuition fees, and other related costs. 

To be eligible for this scheme, students must be children of registered weavers. 

The family income must not exceed ₹2 lakh per annum. 

Students must have secured at least 60% marks in their previous academic year. 

The scheme is open to students from all states in India. 

The application process for this scheme requires several specific steps. 

First, applicants must fill out the application form available on the official website. 

The application form can be downloaded from the Ministry of Textiles' official portal. 

Applicants need to provide proof of their parent's occupation as a weaver. 

This can be done by submitting a copy of the weaver's registration certificate. 

Additionally, applicants must attach their academic records. 

This includes mark sheets from the previous academic year. 

A recent passport-sized photograph is also required. 

The completed application form along with the required documents should be submitted to the local office of the Department of Handloom and Textiles. 

The application must be submitted before the deadline of 31st August each year. 

Once the applications are received, they are reviewed by a committee. 

The committee verifies the eligibility of the applicants based on the submitted documents. 

Successful candidates are then notified about their selection. 

The awards are disbursed directly to the bank accounts of the selected students. 

The disbursement typically occurs in the month of October each year. 

This ensures that students receive their awards in time for the new academic year. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India. 

The Department of Handloom and Textiles at the state level oversees the implementation. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Ministry of Textiles. 

The contact number for the Ministry of Textiles is 011-23062643. 

The official website for more information is www.textiles.gov.in. 

This scheme is part of a broader initiative to uplift the weaving community in India. 

The government recognizes the significant contribution of weavers to the cultural heritage of the country. 

By supporting the education of their children, the government aims to break the cycle of poverty. 

The scheme also encourages weavers to invest in their children's education. 

This is crucial for the long-term sustainability of the weaving industry. 

The Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana is a significant step towards empowering weaver families. 

It reflects the government's commitment to social welfare and education. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also motivates students to excel academically. 

This initiative is expected to enhance the overall educational standards among weaver families. 

It aims to create a new generation of educated individuals from the weaving community. 

The scheme has the potential to transform the socio-economic status of these families. 

By focusing on education, the government is fostering a more skilled workforce. 

This aligns with the national goal of improving literacy rates across the country. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's efforts in promoting inclusive growth. 

It addresses the unique challenges faced by the weaving community. 

The Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana is a vital initiative. 

It showcases the importance of education in achieving economic stability. 

The scheme is a beacon of hope for many families engaged in the weaving profession. 

As of now, the scheme continues to operate and evolve. 

The government remains committed to supporting the educational needs of weaver families. 

This initiative is a crucial part of the larger framework of welfare schemes in India. 

It highlights the importance of targeted support for marginalized communities. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on the lives of many students. 

It encourages them to pursue their dreams and aspirations. 

The Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana is a significant welfare initiative. 

It embodies the spirit of empowerment through education. 

The scheme is an essential tool for fostering social equity. 

It aims to create a brighter future for the children of weavers in India.
